scope: Stage-2 authority, pinned repository tree/README/requirements, entrypoint, training utilities, model definition, optimizer sequence and one representative convection NNCG configuration inspected statically.

unresolved_findings.finding: No repository license is identified at the Stage-2 pinned commit.

The representative convection Adam-L-BFGS-NNCG shell script references an undefined shell variable named switch_epochs inside --opt_params; exact command-line expansion and runtime behavior are therefore not statically clean.
The representative script hard-codes GPU device indices 3-7 while the original GPU model, driver and CUDA runtime context are not documented.
Paper-figure reproduction relies on Weights & Biases account/project access and notebook-side entity configuration rather than a fully self-contained local results archive.
No bundled trained checkpoint or archived experiment-output package was identified in the pinned repository tree; reported outputs must be regenerated or retrieved through external logging workflows.
